# KM-188 — Design: conversation fixture page matching the reference data

**Lane:** design · **Complexity:** 2 · **Model:** claude-opus · **Depends on:** KM-181, KM-182, KM-183, KM-184 · **Serializes with:** none
**Plan context (pinned):** [M1 plan](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/plans/2026-10-01-002-refactor-external-m1-thin-path-plan.md) · [contracts](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/contracts.md) · [roster and graph](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/roster.md) · **Design spec:** `docs/design/khala-chat/RECREATION-SPEC.md` §0 (sources), §22 (M1 matrix), §25
**Exclusive write surfaces:** `apps/web/conversation-fixture.html`, `apps/web/src/ui/conversation/{fixture.tsx,fixture-main.tsx,fixture-data.ts}`, `apps/web/src/landing/showcase.tsx` (props only, so it compiles with the new components; the showcase's look is unchanged beyond what the shared components give it).

## Outcome

`conversation-fixture.html` renders the real product components (`KhalaApp`, `ConversationList`, `ChannelScreen` header and roster, `ChatMessage` rows, `ChatComposer` with chips, `ParticipantDetail`) with **the design's own dataset**. That makes it pixel-comparable to `docs/design/khala-chat/reference/screens/fullbleed-*.png`.

- **Query parameters** select the state: `?theme=dark|light`, `view=list|thread`, `roster=1`, `chips=1`, `detail=<participantId>`, `pop=new|invite|add-agent`, `failed=1`, `empty=1`, `draft=<text>`.
- **M1-omitted design elements** (§22) are absent. KM-186 masks those regions.

## Context and evidence

- The current fixture is `apps/web/src/ui/conversation/fixture.tsx:1-40`: three generic conversations, inline-styled. `apps/web/conversation-fixture.html` has inline `<style>` that imitates bubbles and a 24px padded frame. `ui/conversation/detail.browser.spec.ts` builds and drives it.
- The design dataset is `docs/design/khala-chat/source/Aiur Dashboard.html:4078-4167` (`KH_HUMANS`, `KH_OWNER`, `KH_CONVOS`), plus the agent records at `:2570-2606` (titles) and epic hues at `:2680-2685`.

## Scope

1. **`fixture-data.ts`:** transcribe the design data into product shapes (`ConversationSummary` + `members` + `lastSender` from KM-181, timeline items, C3-style participants).
   - **Humans:** `me` = **You** (Kevin, hue forced 214), `maya` = **Maya Chen** (330), `kai` = **Kai Watanabe** (150).
     - For pixel parity the fixture **overrides** `participantHue` with the design hues through a `hueOverride` map on the fixture provider. This is the only allowed override.
   - **Agents** (display `<Short> · <Owner first>`, `harness`, `idBadge` `#num`, hue = the design's epic hue):

     | Agent | Display | Harness | Owner | idBadge | Hue |
     |---|---|---|---|---|---|
     | AIUR-395 | `Opus · Kevin` | claude | me | `#395` | 150 |
     | AIUR-530 | `Sonnet · Kevin` | claude | me | `#530` | 210 |
     | AIUR-620 | `Codex · Maya` | codex | maya | `#620` | 265 |
     | AIUR-640 | `Codex · Maya` | codex | maya | `#640` | 265 |
     | AIUR-520 | `Sonnet · Kai` | claude | kai | `#520` | 210 |
     | AIUR-540 | `Sonnet · Kai` | claude | kai | `#540` | 210 |

   - **Conversations:** the six live channels from `KH_CONVOS`, in order:

     | Channel | Unread |
     |---|---|
     | Release 0.9 go / no-go | 3 |
     | Events pagination rollout | — |
     | Docs site launch | 2 |
     | Nav shell ↔ auth handoff | — |
     | Theming pass review | 1 |
     | CI flake on migrations | — |

     **Omit** `infra`, `old-launch` and `design-crit` (state channels, [M2]).
   - **Messages:** copy every message of the six channels verbatim, including `<code>`, which becomes backticks. The design's `@395`-style references become the product mention text (`@Opus`, `@Sonnet`, `@Codex`, `@Maya`, `@Kai`).
   - The last "release" message (`failed: true`) is a failed pending send only when `?failed=1`. Otherwise it is omitted, so the receipt reads `Delivered`.
   - Day markers come from the timestamps: Today, Yesterday and Monday, at fixed dates. Fix "now" to `2026-10-02T17:12:00Z` with a UTC fixture clock, and set `TZ`-independent rendering by passing `timeZone: 'UTC'` to KM-180's formatters through their optional parameter. Add that parameter in this ticket only if KM-180 did not provide it; otherwise reuse it.
2. **`fixture.tsx`:** compose `KhalaApp` with those components and read the query parameters. `?empty=1` shows a freshly created empty channel ("Launch"). `?pop=` opens the matching popover anchored to its real button.
3. **`conversation-fixture.html`:** delete the inline `<style>` and the 24px frame. The body is just `<div id="fixture"></div>`. Add `viewport-fit=cover`. Include the Google Fonts `<link>` exactly as `apps/web/index.html` (KM-180).
4. **`fixture-main.tsx`:** import KM-180's `brand/tokens.css` and `ui/khala/khala-app.css` instead of `shell/shell.css`.
5. Update `ui/conversation/detail.browser.spec.ts` selectors for the new fixture: open Maya's detail via her avatar. Keep its two focus assertions.
6. **`landing/showcase.tsx`:** update the props only, so it compiles. Do not restyle it.

## Non-goals

- The comparison itself: **KM-186**.
- Any product component change: **KM-180..184**. If a component cannot express a fixture state, stop and report it; do not fork the component.

## Contract and invariants

- The fixture uses **only** the exported product components and their public props, plus the `hueOverride` provider prop. It has no `kh-*` markup of its own.
- Every dataset string is copied verbatim from the design, except the mention rewriting described above.

## Implementation pointers

### Files

**Create:** `ui/conversation/fixture-data.ts`

**Modify:** `ui/conversation/fixture.tsx`, `ui/conversation/fixture-main.tsx`, `conversation-fixture.html`, `ui/conversation/detail.browser.spec.ts`, `landing/showcase.tsx`

### Worked example

`conversation-fixture.html?theme=dark` at 1440×900, against `reference/screens/fullbleed-1440-dark-thread.png`:
- The list shows the six channels, with "Release 0.9 go / no-go" active.
- The header reads `Release 0.9 go / no-go`, with subtitle `You, Maya, Kai · 3 humans · 6 agents`.
- The thread ends with Sonnet `#540` "Pushing both fixes now. @Kai screenshots attached to the PR." and then `Delivered`. (With `?failed=1`, the failed message, `Not sent` and retry come last.)
- The chips read `@Opus #395 YO`, `@Sonnet #530 YO`, `@Maya`, `+5`.

The design region of the "Your agent?" chip (`.kh-ask`) is absent in the fixture, because it is [M2].

### Steps

1. Transcribe the data, with a unit test asserting counts: 6 channels, 9 members in "release", and 15 messages in "release" counting the day marker and event.
2. Rebuild the fixture and its HTML.
3. Update the detail spec and the showcase props.
4. Spot-check the states in a browser at 1440 and 390.

## Test scenarios

- `ui/conversation/fixture-data.test.ts`:
  1. "release" has 3 humans and 6 agents.
  2. Every agent has a harness and an `idBadge`.
  3. The message texts equal the design strings, after the mention rewrite.
- `ui/conversation/detail.browser.spec.ts` (updated): the existing focus-trap assertions pass against the new fixture.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @khala/web test`
- `pnpm --filter @khala/web test:browser`
- `pnpm typecheck`

**Done when:** each query-parameter state renders without console errors and is visually aligned with its `reference/screens/fullbleed-*` counterpart, apart from the §22 omissions.

## Risks and stop conditions

- If parity needs a component hook other than `hueOverride` and the documented props (for example `idBadge`), stop and ask the Executor which design ticket should own it.

## Complexity rationale

2: data transcription and composition, with no product logic.
